correctness.rationale: For arbitrary field \(\operatorname{char}K\ne2\), the six-parameter form \(D_{B,\ell}\) follows from the bracket x,y. Every pair of projected inputs is covered by four explicit interpolation cases; the trace can be chosen freely while B agrees on one nonzero projected vector. Projective-direction enumeration is a bijective proof of \(q^{q^2+3q+3}\), with \(q^7\) linear and \(q^6\) genuine half-derivations. Standalone verify.py tests the bracket identity exhaustively on basis pairs for all \(q^6\) choices at \(q=3,5\) and pair interpolation of representative families; these finite tests support but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: H3 is the smallest nonabelian nilpotent Lie algebra and base of m0(n); a complete classification of its two-local 1/2-derivations is a natural precise structural problem. It separates nonlinear quotient freedom and central freedom, detects linear two-local maps not themselves half-derivations, and yields an exact odd-field count. These conclusions are not routine substitutions into the existing construction, which provides only nonlinearity examples.
